name: omer-baba-detection

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/omer-baba-atlatici-$(node -p "require('./extension/manifest.json').version").zip && cd extension && zip -r -X -q ../dist/omer-baba-atlatici-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip . -x '*.DS_Store' -x '__MACOSX/*' && cd .. && ls -la dist
scripts.data:faces: node tools/extract-faces.mjs data/videos/train data/faces/train 1 && node tools/extract-faces.mjs data/videos/test data/faces/test 1 && node tools/extract-faces.mjs data/videos/neg data/faces/neg 0.5 && node tools/extract-faces.mjs data/videos/episode data/faces/episode 0.5
scripts.refs:build: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt tools/build-refs.py --pos data/faces/train data/faces/test --neg data/faces/neg --sheet data/reports/tohum-kume.jpg
scripts.refs:eval: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt tools/evaluate.py --train data/faces/train --test data/faces/test --neg data/faces/neg --report data/reports
scripts.report:episode: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements tools/requirements.txt tools/episode-report.py data/faces/episode --json data/reports/bolum.json

description: YouTube'da Kurtlar Vadisi Pusu'nun Ömer Baba sahnelerini yüz tanımayla, tarayıcıda atlayan Chrome eklentisi
author: Ömer Kala
